description: The file 'at_a_glance.php' is a PHP source script for a web-based router/gateway management interface. It handles session management, retrieves device status information (such as battery level, internet connectivity, Wi-Fi status, connected devices, and other network parameters), and generates an HTML page with embedded JavaScript and PHP code to display an 'At a Glance' dashboard for network status monitoring.
